fixture.description: real diagnostic snapshot, repeat one original projectile to 2000 entries; unchanged enemy/player data

interleaved_write_pair_ms.note: Same process and paths, alternating sorted reference and current API. The benefit is small; separate-process write timing was larger but is not used for attribution.

validation_contract.change: Only containers and non-finite float leaves build diagnostic paths and recurse; finite scalar leaves are inspected and then skipped. Field/type/shape validation is unchanged.

write_contract.change: Run snapshots use compact JSON with object-key sorting disabled. Both atomic commits reuse one serialized string; permanent-profile writer behavior is unchanged.

instrumentation: Existing finite, validation, serialize and commit PERFORMANCE_RECORDER scopes were preserved.
limits: This is a bounded microbenchmark of a real payload expanded to 2000 projectiles, not a full gameplay or frame-time improvement claim.
Five timings per version; filesystem and CPU scheduling noise remain. The performance owner receives the exclusive window for the final gameplay benchmark.
No full-project gate or Graphify update was run by this worker.
